description: the creator of worlds, a man with warm brown skin, long dark brown hair and a short dark brown beard, a wise strong face, eyes glowing white, a crown of white crystal shining with light, long robes of deep cosmic black and dark blue full of tiny stars with golden trim and golden nebula patterns, a golden ochre tunic, a dark violet lining, a long starry cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, brown boots, no staff, no orbiting worlds, no ring of runes and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the crystal crown to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, hair, beard, crystal crown, starry robes, colours and drawing style; not the sitting pose and not the hands on the reins: he stands and walks
the character's look in detail: face, hair, beard, crystal crown, starry robes and colours; the hands empty, without the staff, the orbiting worlds and the ring of runes
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
